key.name: broker-host
key.description: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker.

key.name: broker-port
key.description: TCP port of the MQTT broker.

key.name: broker-username
key.description: Username for MQTT broker authentication. Empty for anonymous.

key.name: topic-base
key.description: Base topic prefix for the Media Utopia protocol.

key.name: node-name
key.description: Human-readable name for this Rhythmbox instance when it appears as an MU renderer.

key.name: renderer-enabled
key.description: When enabled, Rhythmbox appears as an MU renderer that external controllers can command.

key.name: controller-enabled
key.description: When enabled, Rhythmbox can control remote MU renderers.

key.name: library-enabled
key.description: When enabled, MU libraries appear as browsable sources in the Rhythmbox sidebar.
